compare.info.totalValue: Every balance the account holds — staked, liquid, savings, unclaimed rewards, open orders and escrow — valued in USD. This is the row that reflects overall wealth; the rows beneath it break it down by asset.
compare.info.topHolderRank: Ranks only the top 100 holders of this coin. A blank value means the account is outside the top 100, not that data is missing. Each coin is ranked separately.
compare.info.totalOps: Operations attributable to a specific dapp, matched by the app tag the dapp writes. It is the sum of the per-dapp counts behind Top dapp, not the account's total operation count — virtual operations such as reward payouts and anything without an app tag are not included.
compare.info.benefactorRewards: A share of a post's author rewards that the author assigned to someone else — often a community, curation project or dapp. Paid in HP plus a liquid HBD portion.
compare.info.producerRewards: Rewards earned for producing blocks as an elected witness. Only witnesses earn these, so the row is blank and unscored for everyone else.
compare.info.interest: Interest paid on HBD held in savings. Only accrues on the savings balance, not on liquid HBD.
compare.info.rewardsPerContent: Total author rewards divided by everything authored in the window — posts and comments. Rewards are converted to an HBD equivalent at the current median price feed so the HP and HIVE portions are included, not just the HBD leg.
